readme: CRIT-007 release-state registry for the Mobile surface.
This file is the ONLY place that may state whether AGI has a live App Store or
Google Play listing. Product copy, billing ownership labels, store links, and
the release scripts all read it through lib/releaseState.ts, so a claim can
never be typed into a screen by hand again.
Flipping a store to "published" is a two-part act: set the status AND record
resolved against the live listing. Accessors fail closed and return null while
either half is missing, so an optimistic status edit alone still surfaces no
store link and no store name.
The website carries the same fact in apps/web/lib/marketing-constants.ts
agree and that neither drifts from the repository's v-mobile-* release tags.

apple.evidence: Zero v-mobile-* tags in this repository and no App Store Connect listing has been verified. store-listing/LISTING-METADATA-IOS.json is a submission draft, not evidence of a live listing; it also records in_app_purchases:false and that no StoreKit product exists, so an 'apple' subscription source cannot legitimately occur yet.

google.evidence: Zero v-mobile-* tags in this repository and no Google Play listing has been verified. store-listing/LISTING-METADATA-ANDROID.json is a submission draft and records that no Google Play Billing products exist, so a 'google' subscription source cannot legitimately occur yet.
